verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no published pricing, no per-resolution price, and no billing caps or spend controls. The only related item is a refund of the AI portion of a conversation when Coach scores it badly. That is a quality-linked guarantee, not a documented outcome-based published price. The 'hard execution caps' item describes security guardrails, not billing caps, so it does not apply to this story.

support.subject: As a support leader, pricing is outcome-based and published — I pay per resolution with caps and controls, not an opaque enterprise quote
